Class FaissIndex

java.lang.Object
tech.kayys.wayang.vector.faiss.FaissIndex
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class FaissIndex extends Object implements AutoCloseable
FAISS Index backed by native FAISS C library via JDK 25 FFM.

Wraps a native FaissIndex pointer and provides Java-friendly operations for vector storage, search, and persistence.

This class manages a mapping between application-level String IDs and FAISS internal idx_t (long) IDs via an IDMap wrapper.
